scope: E browser preparation and X application receipt-loss test facilities; no product change

historical_actual_failures.E_windows: Wheel preflight and sixteen path documents ready; first browser launch looked in the credentialed account default cache, rather than the explicitly prepared task cache.
historical_actual_failures.X_windows: Server original logs prove ClientDisconnect while consuming the publication request, before publish. This was not an accepted publication with lost receipt.

repairs.browser: Persist absolute task cache and grant read access; restore before Playwright driver starts; explicit executable takes priority. Preparation may precede browser installation; actual execution requires existing cache.
repairs.receipt: Real verified HTTPS reads 200 response headers, then closes without application read/JSON decode of receipt body. Underlying transport may buffer bytes. Independently observe four published documents before idempotent retry.

actual_controls.Mac_explicit_browser: Actual Chrome launch with invalid unused cache and environment value 0 passed; browser facility only.

decision: Independent candidate reviewers ready_for_actual_CI; actual Windows retest and full six-direction evidence review still required.
redaction: Raw identities, host paths, tokens, signed references and archive data retained privately; public report excludes them.
